scripts.dev: npm run db:migrate:local && concurrently -k -n worker,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @budget/server" "npm run dev -w @budget/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @budget/web && npm run build -w @budget/server
scripts.check:file-length: git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard -- 'apps/*/src/*.ts' 'apps/*/src/*.tsx' 'apps/*/src/*.css' 'packages/*/src/*.ts' ':!apps/web/src/components/ui/*' | xargs awk 'FNR == 101 { print FILENAME ": over 100 lines; split it"; failed = 1 } END { exit failed }'
scripts.deploy: npm run build -w @budget/web && npm run deploy -w @budget/server
